A line-break-only emphasis inside a table cell still separates the words on either side

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<table><tr><td><strong>Alpha</strong><em><br></em>Beta</td></tr></table>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
